newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Foreswood debuts at 9.10 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Foreswood debuts at 9.10 rgt.

text.p: Foreswood Group Bhd debuted on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange at 9.10 ringgit, against a 3.15 ringgit offer price.
The integrated timber and investment holding concern had offered 6.06 million new shares.
At 0135 GMT, the stock was trading at 9.85 ringgit.
For the year ended December 31, 1995, Foreswood reported a net profit of 10.27 million ringgit or 30.28 cents per share on a turnover of 43.54 million ringgit.
It has forecast a net profit of 3.88 million ringgit in 1996, which includes pre-acquisition profits. Net earnings per share is expected to amount to 32.80 cents for the year.
In a research report issued on Tuesday, Jupiter Securities said Foreswood's issue price of 3.15 puts its price-to-earnings ratio at 9.12 times current earnings.
It estimated fair value for Foreswood at 5.85 ringgit.
